title: share-link resolve answer carries no object label and no field hidden flag, so the landing page prints the API name and can list hidden columns
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from #33346 row 99 (PR #33547; os-dev-report 6886439582, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`; seat ruling 6885601326). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open share link object label` finds #27200 (lookup shows stored id: a different field) and #33346 only.

## What the user sees

A share-link landing page's header prints the object's API name, not its label. Fields the record page hides (injected hidden columns such as `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue`) can still be listed.

## Why (read on `origin/main` `e3f0cfd4` by the #33346 dev)

- `GET /api/v1/share-links/{token}/resolve` answers with no object label: `packages/types/src/share-link-resolve-answer.ts` (`ShareLinkResolvedLink` has none), so the console can only print `link.object_name`.
- The field projection carries `label/type/options/multiple/currencyConfig/reference/displayField` and no `hidden` flag, while the injected system columns are marked hidden at their source (`injected-system-column-provenance.ts`).
- PR #33547 drops the framework system and audit columns on the console side with the record page's own rule; a hidden non-system field cannot be dropped without the flag.

## Acceptance

- The resolve answer carries the object's label (in the request locale, like other labels) and each field's hidden state; the share page's header shows the label and hidden fields are not listed.
